name: Shopify
oneLiner: Hosted ecommerce platform for running an online store, selling in person with Shopify POS, and listing products on social, marketplaces and AI chats.
summary: Shopify is a hosted commerce platform: a flat monthly plan covers the online store, checkout, hosting, point-of-sale software and order management in one admin. Basic, Grow and Advanced can be paid month-to-month or at about 25% less billed yearly, while Plus needs a 1- or 3-year term. Stores that take payments through Shopify Payments avoid the extra transaction fee Shopify charges on orders processed by other payment providers.
notFor: Course creators whose main product is courses, memberships or coaching
Service businesses that mainly need bookings and invoices rather than a product catalog
Teams that need staff logins on the cheapest plan (Basic has no staff accounts)
pros: No Shopify transaction fee on orders paid through Shopify Payments, Shop Pay or PayPal Express Checkout
Every plan includes unlimited products, hosting, a custom domain, SSL and casual in-person selling
Abandoned checkout recovery, discount codes, gift cards and automated sales tax calculation on every plan
10,000 marketing emails a month included, then $1 per 1,000
Month-to-month billing on Basic, Grow and Advanced, or about 25% less billed yearly
Collaborator accounts for freelancers and agencies don't count toward staff limits
cons: Basic has no staff accounts, so a single employee login means moving to Grow at $105/mo month-to-month
Using a third-party payment provider adds a Shopify fee of 2% (Basic), 1% (Grow) or 0.6% (Advanced) on top of the provider's own fees
Stores created since May 12, 2025 pay that fee on the part of an order paid with gift cards or store credit, even with Shopify Payments
Paid themes and third-party apps add one-time and monthly costs that the plan price doesn't show
Live carrier-calculated shipping needs Advanced, or on Grow either yearly billing or an extra monthly fee
Plus has no month-to-month option: it needs a 1- or 3-year term starting at $2,300/mo
